proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature family
proposed_widenings.justification: Martial Arts grants three always-on benefits that are active while the monk meets preconditions (unarmored, wielding only monk weapons, no shield). No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family handles condition-gated passive features without a use_count resource or reset cadence. The 'activation' family mandates UseCountResource and RestResetCadence, neither of which applies here.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: Bonus Unarmed Strike grants the option to make a specific attack (Unarmed Strike) as a Bonus Action. grant_extra_action grants a full extra action (which may exclude Magic); it does not model a scoped bonus-action attack. A distinct effect is needed for 'you may make attack X as a Bonus Action'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: replace_damage_die
proposed_widenings.justification: Martial Arts Die replaces the normal damage die of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons with the Martial Arts die (1d6, scaling via scale_die_size to d12 at Monk L17). modify_roll_substitute exists in v4 taxonomy but covers roll-result substitution (reroll/replace with a die result), not die-expression replacement at the weapon level. ClassFeatureEffect has no slot for this, and the scaling (scale_die_size) has no path to ClassFeatureEffect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can roll 1d6 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike or Monk weapons. This die changes as you gain Monk levels.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_score_substitution on attack/damage rolls
proposed_widenings.justification: Dexterous Attacks permits using DEX in place of STR for attack and damage rolls of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons, and for the save DC of Grapple/Shove. This is a conditional ability-score substitution on rolls, not a numeric bonus (modify_roll_numeric) and not a die-size change. modify_ability_score is explicitly flagged as out-of-scope in the v4 taxonomy residue section, leaving no honest atom for this effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons.

notes: All three sub-features of Martial Arts require surface gaps to be filled. The primary blocker is structural: ClassFeatureMechanics has no 'passive' family for always-on, condition-gated benefits with no resource or reset cadence. Even with that widening, three distinct effect atoms or variants are missing: a bonus-action scoped attack grant (not grant_extra_action), a damage-die replacement effect with die-size scaling, and a DEX-for-STR ability score substitution on attack/damage rolls. No Dhall or JSON authored — unit does not fit the current surface honestly.
